Librogame.title: The Anniversary Edition
Librogame.author: Daniele Pallozzi

Changes.Change: Rewritten for this engine: the nineteen paragraphs, and where each one leads, are those of the original
Time, which on the sheet you count on your fingers, is a visible counter, and at three the book takes you straight to the ending where the copies have run out
The keywords #AMICO and #EGOISTA (FRIEND and SELFISH) are visible counters, and the options that depend on them appear by themselves
Paragraphs 3 and 10, which only sort you onwards and have no text, are not scenes: their conditions sit on the buttons that used to lead to them
The introduction and the rules, which on the sheet sit at the bottom of the page, open scene 1

Librogame.ContentWarnings: None. Queues, robo-tills and a friend who gets virtual-reality sick.
Librogame.Blurb:
April 2065, the fortieth anniversary of Play in Bologna. Angelo Andreino, the grand old man of interactive fiction, has produced a special edition of his first gamebook: forty numbered, signed copies. You and your friend Ale, known as "the Slow-Mo", are there to get one.
The copies will soon run out, and the Slow-Mo is slow. Do you wait for him, or run on alone?

Page.Text:
April 2065: it's the fortieth anniversary of Play in Bologna. For the occasion, the grand old man of interactive fiction, Angelo Andreino, has produced for GL Edizioni a special edition of his first gamebook, in just 40 numbered, signed copies: the legendary Anniversary Edition. You and your friend Ale, known as "the Slow-Mo", are here to get one.
The 40 copies will soon run out, so you'll have to race against time. The book keeps count of the time: as soon as it reaches 3, you've lost.
You are in front of the entrance to Play.

Choice.text: You've already bought the holotickets online
You buy the holotickets at the robo-till

Page.Text: You open the holotickets and stride confidently towards the turnstiles, but the queue is longer than expected: a robo-inspector has malfunctioned, damn it! After a bit of a wait, you're finally in.
The pavilion is already packed: you have to elbow your way through the crowd. The Slow-Mo is slowing you down.

Choice.text: You leave him behind to save time

Page.Text: You queue patiently with the Slow-Mo and wait to finally get your hands on your longed-for copy of the Anniversary Edition.
There's already a queue at the stand. Your holophone rings: it's the Slow-Mo. He's at the Teppuru VR stand and has been taken ill - as usual! - with motion sickness.

Choice.text: You help him, even though the queue will be longer when you get back
You ignore him and leave things as they are
You ignore him and leave things as they are
You ignore him and leave things as they are

Page.Text: You drag the Slow-Mo along and keep elbowing your way forward. In the crowd you think you recognise someone.

Skinny comes over and tells you the copies are running out, but he could sell you his. Just one copy for you and the Slow-Mo... Or maybe you could keep it for yourself? Either way, it hasn't turned out quite as you hoped.
After a while in the queue, they shout from the stand that all the copies of the Anniversary Edition have gone! You didn't make it.

Blast, there's a crazy queue at the robo-till! You bump into Skinny, an old friend from the Librogame's World community: he's picking up his holo-pass, he works for GL Edizioni! Now at last you can go in.
You wriggle free and push on: you can't see the Slow-Mo any more. In the crowd you think you recognise someone.
You thought you'd seen Mau, but it isn't him. There are far too many people, dammit, you can't even walk. It's getting late!
Skinny comes over and tells you both you can forget the queue: he has put two copies aside for you himself. You made it! You hug the Slow-Mo: this Anniversary has got off to the best possible start.

Ah, it really is him, Skinny, the one you met earlier at the robo-till. He tells you to follow him: with the holo-pass you can go through the backstage area and avoid the crowd. What a stroke of luck!
The crush is already enormous, and you have to find the GL Edizioni stand. But what's happened to the Slow-Mo? You can't see him any more!

Choice.text: You look for him with your smartwatch locator
You don't waste time and go on alone

Page.Text: You'll pick the Slow-Mo up later; right now you have just one mission: get to the GL Edizioni stand as fast as you can.
There aren't many people about: you move easily and reach the GL Edizioni stand.
You try to connect, but with so many people the internet is crawling. Even in 2065, for heaven's sake! In the end you manage to find the Slow-Mo at the Teppuru VR stand. You both run to the GL stand.
